note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Research could NOT be completed: the web_search backend returned connection errors on every attempt (searx: Connection refused), and direct fetches of Google/DuckDuckGo result pages were blocked or timed out. Only two pages were readable: the OFAC Sanctions List Search front-end (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) and the Terex Corporation global site (terex.com). The OFAC page is a JavaScript search form - it returns no lookup results to a plain HTTP fetch, so no SDN/non-SDN match or non-match could be established; sanctions_hit is therefore null, NOT a negative finding. terex.com confirms Terex Corporation is a US-listed global equipment maker (FY2025 net sales ~$5.4B per its own investor page) and lists an 'English (India)' locale, but the corporate site contains no sanctions, litigation, regulator or credit-rating disclosure for the Indian entity and is not evidence either way. No Indian court records (NCLT/NCLAT/High Court/eCourts), no regulator actions (SEBI/RBI/CCI/EPFO/GST), no credit rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) and no evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS could be retrieved or checked. All such fields are null because nothing is public in what was reachable - they are not cleared. Per project rules, sanctions/court/criminal matters are never rejection grounds regardless of outcome; this company is not rejected. RECOMMENDATION: re-run this company once search access is restored, specifically against OFAC SDN + consolidated non-SDN, EU consolidated list, UK OFSI, BIS Entity List, eCourts/NCLT, and CRISIL/ICRA/CARE rating directories.
